splits: three leave-one-match-out folds: two whole matches train, one whole match validation; no calibration fitted
dependency: input hashes in R6_IDSSE_INPUTS.json; separate floodlight and streaming parser labels/ball XY must agree on every half before full-spell evaluation
truth: DFL BallStatus/BallPossession continuous source annotation; not proven equivalent to competition effective-control semantics. No unknown fill. No target data or public target GT.
feature_schema: provider_neutral_features_v3: 44 existing names, schema3, positions-only speeds, centered metres to normalized XY, no labels/events/Z/S in features

models.M1: Natural unweighted HGB Alive and conditional Home; max_iter60, leaves15, lr0.1, l2=1, early_stopping=false, seed2027; deterministic 2Hz fitting, 25Hz evaluation
models.M2_dropout: Identical M1 configuration plus one raw-ball-masked/recomputed training copy (0.5/2/5 second windows, seed2027). Change augmentation only; keep labels unchanged.
models.reference: Per-period smooth50 at25FPS; nearest-player carry reference, no fit
models.frozen_V3: Predeclared first V3 fold 1874553, no model selection. Separate schema2 IDSSE adapter uses reported S/3.6 for local player speeds; neutral schema3 still rejected by original Candidate. Cross-provider diagnostic only.

evaluation: complete period spellF1 using unmodified official matching implementation
false D cuts, missed D segments, stable HA switches
probability reliability and missing duration strata
M2_retention: Experimental only if dropout spell improves in >=2/3 matches and mean >=0.01, with no natural per-match spell loss >0.01; otherwise revert. No post-hoc retuning.
limits: Three same-league matches share the home club. Match disjointness does not establish team/league transfer. No confidence interval from frames. No competition promotion or TCN.
budget: 12 small CPU HGB fits; 2 threads; preserve every bundle/probability cache; no extra downloads or sealed test access.
